title: Pierce Downer
claims: The biography gives 1832 for Pierce Downer’s arrival.
It links his house, well and family burial ground.
quote: In 1832 at the age of 50, Pierce traveled to Fort Dearborn Chicago to see his son
limits: Retain the date conflict with the Park District.
Its colonial-settlement framing does not mean the land was previously uninhabited.

title: Downer Burial Place
claims: The district gives 1833 for the first encampment.
It describes dawn-to-dusk visiting and a signed shared driveway off Linscott Avenue.
quote: Access to the burial site is currently by way of a paved driveway that is shared with the adjacent home owner to the south.
limits: No reviewed entrance coordinates or current field inspection.
A shared driveway does not authorize adjoining private property access.

title: The Pierce Downer House
claims: The house is identified at 4437 Seeley Avenue and dated to the early 1840s.
The account distinguishes the original house position from its changed front-door orientation after the street was built.
quote: The Pierce Downer home is currently situated at its original location on the property.
limits: A landmark listing does not establish visitor entry or an allowed public viewpoint.

title: Pierce Downer’s Well
claims: The page identifies the well at 4448 Seeley Avenue, across from the house.
Its text says designation in 2013; its approval field says 2003.
Its proposed household use is expressly qualified as probable.
limits: Do not resolve designation-date conflict by inference.
Current visibility, exact historic position and safe public arrival remain unresolved.

title: Main Street Cemetery
claims: The account dates the cemetery land contribution to 1856 and final interment to 1939.
Its listed 5190 Main Street address needs reconciliation; a municipal PDF search result gives 5158, but that large PDF could not be inspected in the browser.
quote: The cemetery was used until 1939 when Emma Foster Miller was the last to be interred.
limits: Historical entrance orientation is not a current pedestrian-access approval.
The municipal address lead is indexed-only at this checkpoint; do not adopt it as inspected evidence.

title: Downer Burial Ground
claims: The society locates the family ground at 4520 Linscott Avenue.
Its account attributes the family burial on the farm to a flooded-creek obstacle to reaching Main Street Cemetery in 1863.
limits: The encampment location is presented as reported tradition.
Do not infer actual water conditions today or an approved crossing from that account.

title: Architectural Design Review Board minutes, January 18, 2017, pp. 1–4
claims: The minutes identify the historic-landmark petition at 4437 Seeley Avenue.
They distinguish staff presentation from owners’ testimony about changes and the uncertain exact construction year.
quote: A petition seeking a Historic Landmark Designation for the property commonly known as 4437 Seeley Avenue
limits: Historical descriptions of school visits are not current public-entry permission.
Keep reported testimony and oral stories attributed.

title: Downers Grove Main Street Cemetery location reference
claims: The original cemetery photography/location page lists latitude 41.792530 and longitude -88.010619.
limits: Independent location reference; no entrance/access certification.
Photographs explicitly require permission for copying; no photographs copied.
